study: Ludwig & Song 2015, Wolf Trap arts-integrated mathematics PD (AEMDD i3), PK-K, 2-year impact (AIR final grant report; ERIC ED553403)
eval_evidence: Impact evaluation conducted/authored by AIR, the external evaluator under the AEMDD grant; report states 'American Institutes for Research (AIR) is an independent...' and Wolf Trap is the program developer/grantee. AIR has no developer stake in the Wolf Trap program.
developer_evidence: The PD was delivered by Wolf Trap's own teaching artists (the developer's staff/contractors): 'the development program developed by Wolf Trap's project team includes annual summer institutes as well as in-classroom coaching... teaching artists coached teachers in the classroom.'
cascade_evidence: Wolf Trap teaching artists (developer staff/contractors) train and coach the participating teachers directly via the summer institutes and the artist-residency coaching cycle; no train-the-trainer/lead-teacher cascade hop.
counterfactual_evidence: Control schools were assigned to the 'business-as-usual condition'; no alternative arts/math PD provided to controls (Methods).
coaching_evidence: Model = summer institutes (5+3 days) PLUS in-classroom coaching across the school year via the artist-residency 'coaching cycle' (artist co-plans and coaches the teacher in the teacher's own classroom over the residency, gradually releasing to the teacher); recurring in-class coaching.
student_dose_evidence: Framed as 'embedded professional development for teachers'; the arts-integrated lessons replace/transform the teacher's regular math instruction (arts integration during regular instruction), not an added tutoring/pull-out/extra-minutes dose. Note: the teaching artist is physically present and co-teaches lessons with children during the residency (borderline), but the design is teacher-PD/coaching-centric, not a separate student dose.
maturity_evidence: Headline contrast (row 74) is the TWO-YEAR end-of-treatment impact of a 2-year residency program (after a separate planning year); outcomes at end of Year 2, so measured after >=1 prior implementation year. The Year-1 interim wave (secondary) would be first_year.
